metadata.config_choice: Option A (paper's exact datasets) chosen as best judgment while operator away; every tolerance is a literal Table 1 number; re-runnable under Option B/C
metadata.gate_seeds: 100000 + i, i in 0..19 (disjoint from sanity 77770000 and validation 9000x)
metadata.scipy_deviation: scipy unavailable; regularized incomplete beta implemented via Numerical-Recipes continued fraction, validated to machine precision

thresholds.S_of_d: S(d)=I_{3/4}((d+1)/2,1/2) (paper Eq.1, p.3); inverted via fine lookup grid d=0.5..30 step 0.1
thresholds.k_rule: k=15 if n<=1000 else k=20 (paper Section 4.1, p.6, verbatim)
thresholds.method: Kleindessner & von Luxburg, AISTATS 2015, PMLR v38 pp.471-479; E_CAP (spherical-cap) + E_DP (doubling) baseline

tolerance_sources.d12: +/-3; Table 1 rows 6-7 (cube [0,1]^12), E_CAP 7.74 (n=1000, deviation 4.26 -> EXPECTED FAIL) / 9.24 (n=5000, deviation 2.76 -> PASS)
tolerance_sources.d3: DROPPED: no d=3 cell exists anywhere in the paper's Table 1; a tolerance could not be sourced without inventing it
tolerance_sources.d7: +/-2; Table 1 rows 4-5 (sphere S^7), E_CAP 5.88 (n=1000) / 6.85 (n=5000); documented underestimation at high d, Section 4.3
